text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан fails to reach first place at
the
Kikuka Sho. She silently
acknowledges her own
shortcomings...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
However, she won't stop here. She
resolves to
temper herself and grow
even stronger.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Хиши Амадзон, who Нарита Брайан is still
planning
on facing in the Arima Kinen, is
surely growing
stronger as well...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
